range.note: THE RANGE IS THE FIRST FORT'S, NOT THIS COMPONENT'S. It opens on 17 August 1803, the day Swearingen's detachment reached the river at the bend where the fort was to be built (his journal, printed by Quaife), and closes on 16 August 1812, the day after the evacuation, when the fort was burned (data/exclusions.json fort_dearborn_first_1803). No source dates any single building inside it: the fort was built over the months after the arrival, and Whistler's draught of 25 January 1808 is the one day on which every component here is shown standing. It ends before the second fort's 1816 phases begin, so no scene date can resolve the two forts together.
